answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents stake tokens to audit transactions across a multi-layered trust terrace. Randomly sampled multi-agent auditing inspects topological cut verifications across the network graph; if an attacker attempts to isolate peer clusters across a communication canyon, honest verifiers detect the bottleneck. Dishonest collusion triggers stake slashing, cracking malicious nodes like a walnut and enforcing superlinear attacker cost.
